sources.title: Black Forest Labs: FLUX.2 prompting guide
Microsoft Foundry: deploy and use FLUX models

guidelines: Describe the desired result directly; FLUX.2 does not use negative prompts.
State exactly how the supplied reference image must be used.
Use precise object, colour, composition and lighting language.
Keep prompt upsampling disabled when the production prompt is already specific.
Use dimensions that are multiples of 16 and stay inside model pixel limits.
